title: Feedback-arc robustness in random orientations of pseudorandom triangle-free graphs
summary: For an oriented graph $D$, let $\vecα(D)$ be the maximum order of an induced acyclic subdigraph, $\vecχ(D)$ its dichromatic number, and $\mathrm{fas}(D)$ the minimum number of arcs whose deletion makes $D$ acyclic. We prove that for every fixed $ζ\in (0, 1/2)$, there are triangle-free graphs $G_n$ on $n$ vertices such that a uniformly random orientation $D_n$ satisfies, $$ \left( \frac{1}{2} - ζ\right) e(G_n[U]) < \mathrm{fas}(D_n[U]) \leq \frac{1}{2} e(G_n[U]) $$ with probability at least $1-\exp\!\left[-Ω_ζ\!\left(\sqrt n\,(\log n)^{3/2}\right)\right]$ simultaneously for every vertex set…
